notes.title: Bug Patch and a Thank You
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for playing Group Project Sim! We honestly didn't expect to see so many people find our game this fast. This is our first game so it's been really exciting to see y'alls reactions on what we have worked on for so long. This game has only been out a couple weeks but we've already had a Lets Play, hundreds of players, and a streamer. Who knows what's coming?

We want to congratulate all of you on the achievements that you've unlocked. Nice job to those of you who worked to get Jackpot, and for our resident Puzzle Solvers you did awesome figuring out the alternate solutions to Alyssa's Adventure. We hope the 7% of you who've Achieved Greatness enjoyed the surprise at the end- it's not easy to unlock all the achievements so we wanted the reward to be something special. 

Anyways, we've fixed a few bugs such as the vending machine sound glitch and a strange condition that made it difficult to get Untouchable after you unlocked MVP. We appreciate your help for making this a better game.
